correctness.rationale: The genus is five by Riemann-Hurwitz for the 16-fold (C2)^4 cover with five order-two inertia groups. Five distinct genus-one character summands exhaust H^0(C,Omega), and the character averaging correspondence is of 2-power degree, hence prime to 5 and preserves p-divisible groups and p-rank/a-number. The Legendre Hasse coefficient for characteristic 5 is lambda^2-lambda+1; each pair of four-point-subset equations reduces to independent equianharmonic roots alpha,beta in F25 with alpha+beta=alpha beta=1. The third equalities fail, and the simple roots make each pair transverse. Inclusion/exclusion yields 20 double points, 10q-70 single-divisor points, q²-15q+56 ordinary points for even m; odd m all ordinary. Independent distinct F25 arithmetic enumerated 506 ordered parameter pairs: (r0,r1,r2)=(306,180,20), each divisor 44 points, each of 10 pairs two points, no triples, ten Frobenius two-cycles. Finite computation corroborates, not the source of arbitrary-m proof.
